input.command: cd /workspace && find . -type f -not -path './.yecoding/*' | sort && echo '---' && wc -l dotenv/*.py tests/*.py
cd /workspace && cat -n tests/test_acceptance.py && echo '--- main.py relevant ---' && grep -n "decode\|escape\|quoted\|unquoted" dotenv/*.py
cd /workspace && git status --short 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; echo '--- tests ---'; python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -20

cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -25; echo '--- repro ---'; python -c "
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream
for s in ['X=\"line\\\\nnext\"', \"X='a\\\\tb'\", 'X=a\\\\nb', 'X=\"a\\\\tb\\\\\"c\"']:
    rows=list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(s)))
    print(repr(s), '->', repr(rows[0].value))
"
cd /workspace && grep -n "Binding\|parse_stream\|value" dotenv/main.py | head -60 && echo '--- variables.py ---' && cat -n dotenv/variables.py | sed -n '1,40p'
